posts.a: Stages of a 5 AM pre-workout, ranked by how well I'm doing
s: 5:02 AM: Scoop one. Face tingles. I am a statue of discipline.
5:20 AM: Warmup set. I have named the bar. It's Gary.
5:45 AM: Rewriting my 5-year plan between sets of rows.
6:30 AM: Crash. Sitting on the leg press, staring at a fire extinguisher.
7:15 AM: Drinking cold brew in the car, calling it recovery.
posts.caption:
Gary and I have been through a lot.

posts.caption:
